POL-CLAIM.coverage: Finite witness coverage only; not specification completeness.
POL-CLAIM.requirement: Only REVIEWED_ARTIFACT_IDENTITY with the exact scenario and artifact-byte-identity scope is admitted.

REVIEW-DEFINITIONS.coverage: One isolated finite witness; not exhaustive predicate or policy coverage.
REVIEW-DEFINITIONS.requirement: Catalog procedure and dependency definitions must equal the independently supplied contract requirements.

REVIEW-SCENARIO.coverage: One isolated finite witness; not exhaustive predicate or policy coverage.
REVIEW-SCENARIO.requirement: Requested scenario must equal the exact scenario contract scenario.

REVIEW-SCOPE.coverage: One isolated finite witness; not exhaustive predicate or policy coverage.
REVIEW-SCOPE.requirement: Requested claim scope must equal the signed scenario contract scope.

REVIEW-SUPPORTED_CONTRACT.coverage: One isolated finite witness; not exhaustive predicate or policy coverage.
REVIEW-SUPPORTED_CONTRACT.requirement: A contract for EXTERNAL_TASK_SUCCESS is outside this consumer even when signatures and claim bindings agree.
